actions.title: Create controlled JewelLink CONSULTANT denial persona
actions.purpose: Authenticated JewelLink SSO smoke must prove CONSULTANT users fail closed in JewelHire.
constraints: Company must be the pilot company comp_1.
User must be active and MFA-backed for the smoke window.
Primary location should be one of: loc_1, loc_2, loc_3, loc_4, loc_5, loc_6.
User must not be included in the JewelHire platform-admin allowlist.
Use a controlled test mailbox only; do not record the full address in Git or qa-runs.
actions.verification: Rerun qa:pilot-roster and require PASS Consultant denial candidate exists.

actions.title: Create controlled active user in a paused JewelLink company
actions.purpose: Authenticated JewelLink SSO smoke must prove paused-company access fails closed in JewelHire.
constraints: Company must be paused in JewelLink.
User must be active and MFA-backed for the smoke window.
User must not belong to the pilot company.
User must not be included in the JewelHire platform-admin allowlist.
Use a controlled test mailbox only; do not record the full address in Git or qa-runs.
actions.verification: Rerun qa:pilot-roster and require PASS paused-company denial candidate exists.
